title: The Best Ocean Photos of the Year
gist: The Ocean Photographer of the Year 2026 awards, run by Oceanographic Magazine and Blancpain, selected 84 finalists across nine categories spanning drone, coastal, and underwater imagery highlighting both ocean wonder and threats to marine ecosystems.

insights.claim: The Ocean Photographer of the Year 2026 awards, run by Oceanographic Magazine and watchmaker Blancpain, selected 84 image finalists across nine categories, spanning aerial, coastal, and underwater perspectives.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Documents a recurring annual ocean-photography competition co-sponsored by a luxury watch brand (Blancpain), of note for brand-marketing/conservation-partnership context rather than direct market impact.
insights.quote: there are 84 image finalists in total...The contest features nine categories, and is run by Oceanographic Magazine and Blancpain.

insights.claim: Contest founder and director Will Harrison says the photographs aim to surface stories about growing pressures on ocean ecosystems, framing the competition's finalist images as bearing witness to environmental threats as well as capturing beauty.
insights.speaker: Will Harrison (quoted by David Nield)
insights.so_what: Positions the competition explicitly as an ocean-conservation advocacy vehicle, not purely an aesthetic photography contest.
insights.quote: These photographs don't just capture what's beneath the surface; they surface the stories our planet most needs us to hear...As the pressures on our ocean grow, so does the importance of the artists who bear witness to them.
